class methylseg.MethylSegConfig(config_dict)[source]

Lightweight helper that knows how to build a serializable dictionary from a MethylSegPathway instance and how to write/read YAML.

classmethod from_instance(inst, out_dir=None)[source]

Build a serializable config dict from a MethylSegPathway instance.

  • DataFrames are saved to feather files in inst.out_dir (or out_dir if provided).

  • scikit-learn objects (kmeans, pca, scaler) are joblib-dumped (optional).
